a.lede: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added the PHP2Shell vulnerabilities to its catalog of actively exploited security flaws and ordered federal agencies to patch their systems by Thursday. [...]
a.title: CISA confirms PHP2Shell vulnerabilities now exploited in attacks

b.lede: The Tailscale security team is working to patch almost a dozen security vulnerabilities that could be exploited to steal credentials, crash servers, gain root privileges, and more. [...]
b.title: Tailscale warns of SSH flaws allowing root privilege escalation
